items.title: Jackie Cain and Roy Kral interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, March 22, 1998
items.q: we made that album “Time and Love,” which is the album we did for Creed Taylor... We’d done maybe four albums for him on Verve

ctx.x: She would start and then I answer, and it kept alternating.

But originally it wasn’t that way. Originally we had a set ending, and it was sort of in harmony with the horn and when we did it with Charlie. But then later on we re-recorded it because I think it was Creed Taylor wanted us to do it again. And we did an album with a big band, you know. It was a great time because we did it with was it—
